verdict.rationale: Deel provides webhooks for real-time, event-driven integrations (avoiding polling) and an MCP server exposing tools (e.g., createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts) that agents can invoke, which together could underpin autonomous background workflows. However there is no evidence of a native scheduler, workflow/automation builder, or persistent background job runner within Deel itself — automation would have to be built externally using these primitives. Missing for 10: a documented autonomous scheduling/automation engine, evidence of agents running tasks continuously without human trigger, and any hands-on confirmation of such automations working reliably.
